window: Covering reporting published in the past 24-48 hours (Sept 3-4). South America got dedicated effort, turning up fresh Brazil and Venezuela busts after most Colombian, Peruvian and Bolivian leads proved to be stale year-to-date tallies or the same Cabo de la Vela/Cartagena cocaine interception already logged yesterday. No new SOUTHCOM/Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere strike or materially new development in the one-year-anniversary story occurred in this window, so the ongoing section is empty today.
